    Mild contours: data and first consequences #

    MildContour x y: a contour v = v'·α, w = w'·β from x to y (equal nonzero values, not interlaced) with the generator ρ = π(y) of the non-invertible endomorphisms of y and ω ≫ ρ ≠ 0 (non-deep, transit side). Basic facts, and [mild] Lemma 2.1, steps 1–2 (MildContour.rho_sq, MildContour.step2).

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.MildContour {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] (x y : P) :
    Type

    A contour {v'·α, w'·β} from x to y with ρ = π(y) and ω ≫ ρ ≠ 0.

    • sv : P
    • sw : P
    • v' : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk x) (RayVert.mk self.sv)
    • α : RayVert.mk self.sv ⟶ RayVert.mk y
    • w' : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk x) (RayVert.mk self.sw)
    • β : RayVert.mk self.sw ⟶ RayVert.mk y
    • hval : pathVal (self.v'.cons self.α) = pathVal (self.w'.cons self.β)
    • h0 : pathVal (self.v'.cons self.α) ≠ 0
    • hni : ¬Interlaced (self.v'.cons self.α) (self.w'.cons self.β)
    • ρ : y ⟶ y
    • hρ (e : y ⟶ y) : ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso e → ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ e = rpow self.ρ n
    • hωρ : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (pathVal (self.v'.cons self.α)) self.ρ ≠ 0
